hero.eyebrow: Cloud sync for game saves · v1.7.0
hero.subtitle: A small daemon snapshots your saves every time you finish playing, hashes every file, and lets you roll back to any previous version. Free until your library outgrows it. Self-host the same binary if you'd rather.
platforms.title: Detects saves on
features.title: Built like a tool, not a product page
features.subtitle: Six things that matter, six things that ship.
features.versioned.title: Every backup is a snapshot
features.versioned.body: Old versions don't expire. Roll back three weeks, three months, three years — same UI, both tiers.
features.verified.title: SHA-256 on every file
features.verified.body: Content-addressed snapshots, re-hashed on restore. Silent corruption gets caught.
features.detect.title: Picks up your library on its own
features.detect.body: Thousands of titles via the Ludusavi manifest, plus live detection for Steam, Epic, GOG, Bottles and Lutris.
features.crossplat.title: Windows, macOS, Linux
features.crossplat.body: One desktop app, one account, one set of saves. Proton/Wine prefixes detected as first-class targets.
features.export.title: Yours to leave with
features.export.body: Export every save as the game wrote it — no archive, no proprietary wrapper. Free tier included.
features.selfhost.title: Same binary, your hardware
features.selfhost.body: Server is a single Rust binary. AGPL-3.0, no licensing tier, runs fine on a Raspberry Pi.
how.title: Three steps. No setup.
how.subtitle: Install the desktop app, sign in once, and forget it's there.
how.s1_body: Download the app for your OS. One magic-link sign-in. The daemon starts on boot.
how.s2_body: Hoard scans Steam, Epic, GOG, Wine prefixes, Bottles. Adds the saves it finds, asks before tracking.
how.s3_body: Every time a game closes, the save gets hashed and uploaded. Roll back from the Library tab.
security.title: Boring on purpose.
security.subtitle: No magic, no telemetry, no proprietary formats. Just the stuff a save-sync product should already have.
security.eu_body: Postgres and object storage in Frankfurt. No replication outside the EU.
security.sha_body: Every file hashed on upload, re-hashed on restore. Silent bit-rot doesn't survive a round trip.
security.agpl_body: Server, agent, desktop — all on GitHub. Read it, fork it, run it on your own hardware.
security.export_body: Export every save in the game's original format. No archive, no proprietary wrapper.
cta_section.title: Free until you outgrow it.
cta_section.body: 1 GB, 3 devices, full history, no card. Pro is 4,49 €/mo when the library gets serious.

pricing.subtitle: Free is a real plan, not a trial. Upgrade when the storage runs out — your data and history come along.
pricing.note_cancel_body: No contracts. Cancel and you stay on Pro until the period ends, then drop to Free. Your data stays.
pricing.note_mor_body: VAT and invoicing handled by our Merchant of Record. Prices in EUR, tax included.
pricing.note_lockin_body: Export every save in the game's original format. Self-host the same binary at any point.
pricing.compare_subtitle: Everything every plan ships with — laid flat.

help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Most answers are in the docs. For everything else, email us — we read every message.
help.no_results: No matches. Try a shorter query, or email support.
help.faq_a1: Yes. 1 GB, 3 devices, unlimited tracked saves, full version history, no card. Most players never need to upgrade.
help.faq_q2: What happens if I cancel Pro?
help.faq_a2: You stay on Pro until the billing period ends, then drop to Free. Uploads pause if you're over the Free quota; nothing is deleted.
help.faq_a3: Yes. The server is one Rust binary, AGPL-3.0. See docs/install.md in the repo for Docker and bare-metal setups.
help.faq_a4: Snapshots are encrypted at rest on Cloudflare R2. End-to-end encryption (keys we can't read) is on the roadmap for users who want it.
help.faq_a5: EU (Frankfurt) — both Postgres and object storage. We don't replicate outside the EU.
help.faq_q6: Is there a per-save size limit?
help.faq_a6: 200 MB per save on Free, 2 GB on Pro. Modern games rarely cross 200 MB of save data; if yours do, Pro covers it.
help.faq_a7: Rolling 15-minute window: 500 MB on Free, 1 GB on Pro. Plenty for normal sync. Hit it and the desktop app pauses, then resumes on its own.
help.contact_body: Email support@hoard.services or open a GitHub issue. Pro accounts get next-business-day replies.
footer.tagline: Versioned cloud sync for game saves. Built in Rust, open source.
